identity.name: Saxonia Thin
identity.one_liner: Lange's thinnest watch, reduced to hours and minutes only, introduced in this 39mm case with a copper-blue gold-flux dial in 2018.

narrative.story: The Saxonia Thin strips Lange's dress-watch line to hours and minutes alone, using the L093.1 hand-wound movement to keep the case under 6.4mm thick. This reference's copper-blue dial, made from solid silver with a gold-flux coating, was a departure from the brand's usual silver and black options and became one of the more frequently discussed dial colors in the current Saxonia lineup.
narrative.collector_notes: Because the dial is gold-flux over solid silver rather than lacquered, color saturation varies slightly piece to piece; collectors compare examples side by side before buying rather than relying on catalog photography.
